name: Sofia Almeida
bio:
Sofia's journey into motorsport logistics began somewhat unexpectedly after a career in international shipping. A chance encounter with a local racing team led to her offering her organizational skills, quickly becoming indispensable. Her meticulous nature and ability to anticipate potential problems make her an exceptional logistics coordinator. 

Sofia thrives on the pressure of race weekends, ensuring that everything from spare parts to catering arrives on time and in perfect condition. She is known for her calm demeanor and her knack for finding solutions to seemingly impossible logistical challenges. What sets Sofia apart is her deep understanding of international regulations and customs procedures, a skill honed from her previous life, which she applies to navigate the complexities of global motorsport events.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled bob with a slight wave
physical.description: Sofia is a woman of medium height with a warm, approachable demeanor and a practical style.

quirks: Insists on using a physical planner despite having a digital calendar.
Always carries a small sewing kit for unexpected repairs.
Has a specific brand of Portuguese coffee she insists on having at every race event.
